title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — Measuring the Fee Ceiling by Pay Frequency
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — the room under the fee ceiling for a next-business-day bank transfer fee, by pay frequency.**

The cap method measures the bank fee room by the plan's pay frequency as the employer reports it:

- **weekly pay:** the tier's fee ceiling per pay period is compared with the fees net of their reversals carrying the transfer's pay date together with those carrying the pay date of the plan's latest period close line;
- **semimonthly pay:** the tier's fee ceiling per pay period is first multiplied by the calendar days from the pay date of the plan's latest period close line to the transfer's pay date and divided by fourteen, and then compared with the fees net of their reversals carrying the transfer's pay date;
- **biweekly pay:** the bank fee room is the tier's fee ceiling per pay period less the fees net of their reversals carrying the transfer's pay date;
- a plan with no period close line yet is measured as for biweekly pay.

The room is that ceiling, so measured, less those fees.

| Pay frequency | Ceiling used | Fees counted against it |
|---|---|---|
| weekly | the tier's fee ceiling | the transfer's pay period and the latest closed pay period together |
| semimonthly | the tier's fee ceiling times the days from the latest closed pay date to the transfer's pay date, divided by fourteen | the transfer's pay period |
| biweekly, or no period close yet | the tier's fee ceiling | the transfer's pay period |

## Hypothetical, on a tier with an 11.99 USD fee ceiling

- Weekly: fees of 2.98 USD carrying the transfer's pay date and 5.97 USD carrying the last closed pay date leave 11.99 less 8.95, 3.04 USD of room.
- Semimonthly: 16 days from the last closed pay date to the transfer's pay date give a ceiling of 11.99 times 16 divided by fourteen, 13.702857 USD; with 2.98 USD of fees, the room is 10.722857 USD.
- Biweekly: fees of 2.98 USD leave 9.01 USD.
